title: Highlight
description: A curated highlight of a station-owned content document, enabling network-level curation alongside the original. The document ID must carry a -highlight suffix. At ingest time, the linked document's profiles are copied into meta.profiles so that highlights appear in queries alongside their source documents.

originalWebPageLink.description: A web page link that carries a 'canonical' rel, pointing to the station-owned document's web presence.

equivalentRelatedItemLink.description: A related-item link that carries an 'equivalent' rel, pointing to the original station-owned document.

id.description: The identifier for this highlight document. Must end with the -highlight suffix.

profiles.description: Must include /v1/profiles/publishable (which enforces title, owners, and brandings) and /v1/profiles/internal-link (which enforces documentLink).

webPages.description: Links to web pages associated with this highlight. Must include at least one link with the 'canonical' relationship pointing to the station-owned URL.

relatedItems.description: Links to documents with associative relationships. Must include at least one link with the 'equivalent' relationship pointing to the original station-owned document.
